elements.name: html
elements.contentModel: A head element followed by a body element.

elements.name: head
elements.contentModel: If the document is an iframe srcdoc document or if title information is available from a higher-level protocol: Zero or more elements of metadata content , of which no more than one is a title element and no more than one is a base element. Otherwise: One or more elements of metadata content , of which exactly one is a title element and no more than one is a base element.

elements.name: title
elements.contentModel: Text that is not inter-element whitespace .

elements.name: link
categories: If the element is allowed in the body : flow content .
If the element is allowed in the body : phrasing content .

elements.name: meta
categories: If the itemprop attribute is present: flow content .
If the itemprop attribute is present: phrasing content .

elements.name: style
elements.contentModel: Text that gives a conformant style sheet .

elements.name: hgroup
elements.contentModel: Zero or more p elements, followed by one h1 , h2 , h3 , h4 , h5 , or h6 element, followed by zero or more p elements, optionally intermixed with script-supporting elements .

elements.name: header
elements.contentModel: Flow content , but with no header or footer element descendants.

elements.name: footer
elements.contentModel: Flow content , but with no header or footer element descendants.

elements.name: address
elements.contentModel: Flow content , but with no heading content descendants, no sectioning content descendants, and no header , footer , or address element descendants.

elements.name: ol
elements.contentModel: Zero or more li and script-supporting elements.
categories: If the element's children include at least one li element: Palpable content .

elements.name: ul
elements.contentModel: Zero or more li and script-supporting elements.
categories: If the element's children include at least one li element: Palpable content .

elements.name: menu
elements.contentModel: Zero or more li and script-supporting elements.
categories: If the element's children include at least one li element: Palpable content .

elements.name: dl
elements.contentModel: Either: Zero or more groups each consisting of one or more dt elements followed by one or more dd elements, optionally intermixed with script-supporting elements . Or: One or more div elements, optionally intermixed with script-supporting elements .
categories: If the element's children include at least one name-value group: Palpable content .

elements.name: dt
elements.contentModel: Flow content , but with no header , footer , sectioning content , or heading content descendants.

elements.name: figure
elements.contentModel: Either: one figcaption element followed by flow content . Or: flow content followed by one figcaption element. Or: flow content .

elements.name: div
elements.contentModel: If the element is a child of a dl element: One or more dt elements followed by one or more dd elements, optionally intermixed with script-supporting elements . Otherwise, if the element is a descendant of an option element, an optgroup element, or a select element: transparent . Otherwise: flow content .

elements.name: a
elements.contentModel: Transparent , but there must be no interactive content descendant, a element descendant, or descendant with the tabindex attribute specified.
categories: If the element has an href attribute: Interactive content .

elements.name: dfn
elements.contentModel: Phrasing content , but there must be no dfn element descendants.

elements.name: time
elements.contentModel: If the element has a datetime attribute: Phrasing content . Otherwise: Text , but must match requirements described in prose below.

elements.name: picture
elements.contentModel: Zero or more source elements, followed by one img element, optionally intermixed with script-supporting elements .

elements.name: img
categories: If the element has a usemap or controls attribute: Interactive content .

elements.name: video
elements.contentModel: If the element has a src attribute: zero or more track elements, then transparent , but with no media element descendants. If the element does not have a src attribute: zero or more source elements, then zero or more track elements, then transparent , but with no media element descendants.
categories: If the element has a controls attribute: Interactive content .

elements.name: audio
elements.contentModel: If the element has a src attribute: zero or more track elements, then transparent , but with no media element descendants. If the element does not have a src attribute: zero or more source elements, then zero or more track elements, then transparent , but with no media element descendants.
categories: If the element has a controls attribute: Interactive content .
If the element has a controls attribute: Palpable content .

elements.name: table
elements.contentModel: In this order: optionally a caption element, followed by zero or more colgroup elements, followed optionally by a thead element, followed by either zero or more tbody elements or one or more tr elements, followed optionally by a tfoot element, optionally intermixed with one or more script-supporting elements .

elements.name: caption
elements.contentModel: Flow content , but with no descendant table elements.

elements.name: colgroup
elements.contentModel: If the span attribute is present: Nothing . If the span attribute is absent: Zero or more col and template elements.

elements.name: tbody
elements.contentModel: Zero or more tr and script-supporting elements.

elements.name: thead
elements.contentModel: Zero or more tr and script-supporting elements.

elements.name: tfoot
elements.contentModel: Zero or more tr and script-supporting elements.

elements.name: tr
elements.contentModel: Zero or more td , th , and script-supporting elements.

elements.name: th
elements.contentModel: Flow content , but with no header , footer , sectioning content , or heading content descendants.

elements.name: form
elements.contentModel: Flow content , but with no form element descendants.

elements.name: label
elements.contentModel: Phrasing content , but with no descendant labelable elements unless it is the element's labeled control , and no descendant label elements.

elements.name: input
categories: If the type attribute is not in the Hidden state: Interactive content .
If the type attribute is not in the Hidden state: Listed , labelable , submittable , resettable , and autocapitalize-and-autocorrect inheriting form-associated element .
If the type attribute is in the Hidden state: Listed , submittable , resettable , and autocapitalize-and-autocorrect inheriting form-associated element .
If the type attribute is not in the Hidden state: Palpable content .

elements.name: button
elements.contentModel: Phrasing content , but there must be no interactive content descendant and no descendant with the tabindex attribute specified. If the element is the first child of a select element, then it may also have one descendant selectedcontent element.
categories: Listed , labelable , submittable , and autocapitalize-and-autocorrect inheriting form-associated element .

elements.name: select
elements.contentModel: Zero or one button elements if the select is a drop-down box , followed by zero or more option elements, optgroup elements, hr elements, script-supporting elements , noscript elements, or div elements.
categories: Listed , labelable , submittable , resettable , and autocapitalize-and-autocorrect inheriting form-associated element .

elements.name: datalist
elements.contentModel: Either: phrasing content . element descendant, since there might be zero suggestions -- Or: Zero or more option and script-supporting elements.

elements.name: optgroup
elements.contentModel: Zero or one legend element followed by zero or more option elements, script-supporting elements , noscript elements, or div elements.

elements.name: option
elements.contentModel: If the element has a label attribute and a value attribute: Nothing . If the element has a label attribute but no value attribute: Text . If the element has no label attribute and is not a descendant of a datalist element: Zero or more div elements or phrasing content , but there must be no interactive content descendant, datalist element descendant, object element descendant, or descendant with the tabindex attribute specified If the element has no label attribute and is a descendant of a datalist element: Text .

elements.name: textarea
categories: Listed , labelable , submittable , resettable , and autocapitalize-and-autocorrect inheriting form-associated element .

elements.name: output
categories: Listed , labelable , resettable , and autocapitalize-and-autocorrect inheriting form-associated element .

elements.name: progress
elements.contentModel: Phrasing content , but there must be no progress element descendants.

elements.name: meter
elements.contentModel: Phrasing content , but there must be no meter element descendants.

elements.name: fieldset
elements.contentModel: Optionally, a legend element, followed by flow content .
categories: Listed and autocapitalize-and-autocorrect inheriting form-associated element .

elements.name: legend
elements.contentModel: If the element is a child of an optgroup element: Phrasing content , but there must be no interactive content and no descendant with the tabindex attribute. Otherwise: Phrasing content , optionally intermixed with heading content .

elements.name: details
elements.contentModel: One summary element followed by flow content .

elements.name: summary
elements.contentModel: Phrasing content , optionally intermixed with heading content .

elements.name: script
elements.contentModel: If there is no src attribute, depends on the value of the type attribute, but must match script content restrictions . If there is a src attribute, the element must be either empty or contain only script documentation that also matches script content restrictions .

elements.name: noscript
elements.contentModel: When scripting is disabled , in a head element: in any order, zero or more link elements, zero or more style elements, and zero or more meta elements. When scripting is disabled , not in a head element: transparent , but there must be no noscript element descendants. Otherwise: text that conforms to the requirements given in the prose.

elements.name: canvas
elements.contentModel: Transparent , but with no interactive content descendants except for a elements, img elements with usemap attributes, button elements, input elements whose type attribute are in the Checkbox or Radio Button states, input elements that are buttons , and select elements with a multiple attribute or a display size greater than 1.
